```python
import pandas as pd
import narwhals as nw

df = pd.DataFrame({
    "id": [1, 2, 3],
    "jan": [10, 20, 30],
    "feb": [11, 21, 31],
    "mar": [12, 22, 32],
})

df_nw = nw.from_native(df, eager_only=True)

long_nw = df_nw.unpivot(
    on=["jan", "feb", "mar"],
    index=["id"],
    variable_name="month",
    value_name="sales",
)

long_df = long_nw.to_native()
print(long_df)
```
